evidence.title: GitHub - UretzkyZvi/planner: Planner Component: A React component for dynamic appointment management

name: Planner
summary: Copy-in React scheduling component with day/week/month/year views, resource management and drag-and-drop.
description: An adaptable scheduling component for React: appointments across daily, weekly, monthly and yearly timelines, assignable resources such as rooms and personnel, and drag-and-drop rescheduling powered by Atlassian's Pragmatic drag and drop. Styled with shadcn/ui components; you install it by copying the planner component, models, contexts and services into your project (react-day-picker, date-fns and @atlaskit/pragmatic-drag-and-drop required).
contains: day, week, month and year scheduling views
drag-and-drop rescheduling via Pragmatic drag and drop
install by copying component, models, contexts and services
